labels.what: Baseline at the current Blitz pin: per-fixture verdicts (fidelity/ACCEPTANCE.md criterion IDs), layout-diff attribution and per-WPT-directory results of one fidelity/run-all.mjs run, re-shaped by extract.mjs. Phase A: measurement only.

knownIssues: run-all's layoutDiff.firstBox.finalDelta (fidelity/combine/verdicts.mjs fromLayoutDiffRow) is the delta of the LAST per_layer key, which for boxes is the diagnostic unrounded layer B0u, not the final layout_normalize layer. Not fixed here (combine/ is not this baseline's path); every fixtures/<key>.json carries layoutDiffLayers.firstBox.finalLayerDelta from layout-diff's own summary instead.

layout-diff exits 2 by design (receipt: html_normalize hoist fails self-consistency; oss-postmark-receipt: Helvetica stack not in FONT_ALIASES, input parity fails, attribution INVALID). Recorded per fixture, not a crash.

acceptance.mapping: DESIGN TARGET (integration mapping): corpus verdicts are copied by criterion ID; oracles map qpdf->PDF-Q1 (warnings fail), veraPDF on the PDF/A render->PDF-A1 (on the plain render it is a negative control, kind 'control', excluded from totals), text->EXT-2 (all body tokens vs Chrome's PDF), copy-paste->EXT-3, barcode->BOL-B1 (second decoder pair), layout pages->REF-P, layout consensus->REF-W; WPT pin->WPT-1, ratchet->WPT-2. layout-diff is attribution only (no PASS/FAIL).

v1.note: this baseline had no pdf-probe section before the re-score

inputMap.why: The pin run (20261021T054154Z) ran pdf-probe with --fixtures notification,invoice (its env.command), so layout-diff kept no vellora/chrome PDF pair for the other 7 fixtures. The vellora side is re-rendered here by the same producer the chain's pdf-probe uses (crates/vellora-core/examples/layout_dump --pdf, i.e. vellora_core::render) built from the pin source 8009f96 (crates/Cargo identical to the run's 2c66544; Blitz git rev 2003ba5), from the layout-diff native.html that is byte-identical in the pin, 00-start and 09 run copies. The binary reproduces the pin run's invoice and notification vellora.pdf and vellora-dump.json byte for byte. The Chrome side is the chain's own pdf-probe chrome.pdf (09 run copy), whose PyMuPDF word fingerprint equals reference.chromeWordsSha256 of port/00-start and port/09 for every fixture, so pin pair keys name the same Chrome words as the chain's.
